capabilities: Explain selected words or passages in place
Generate recall prompts and check questions with feedback
Run request blocks with file references, skills and images
Read PDF, EPUB and Word documents with page citations
extras: Desktop uses the bundled Pi runtime; mobile runs a reduced agent with API keys kept in the device keychain, no shell, no file tools outside the vault and no Pi skills or MCP servers. Scanned PDFs without a text layer cannot be read (no OCR). main.js is about 9 MB.
intentEvidence: Coming from ICPA (icpa-agent)? ICAP imports its settings on first start; then remove the old plugin.
motivation: The name comes from the ICAP framework (Chi & Wylie, 2014): learning deepens from Passive to Active, Constructive and Interactive.
problem: Studying from notes is passive: Obsidian has no built-in way to get explanations, self-testing or feedback without switching to a separate chat window.

relations.evidence: Coming from ICPA (icpa-agent)? ICAP imports its settings on first start; then remove the old plugin.
Its agent is Pi, built into the plugin and connected to your own model provider
Pi stores it in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json, shared with the Pi CLI.

summary: In-note learning agent that writes explanations, recall prompts, quiz feedback and request blocks into your notes, powered by the Pi runtime.
